name: Kusakabe Shinnosuke
source:
3rd year high school student.
An honor student that's part of the cultural festival committee.
A reliable upperclassman that supports all the other students equally.
He's old friends with [url=/c49298]Shion[/url] and is one of the few who knows his secrets.
